name: Skeleton
summary: A placeholder shape that stands where content will appear while it loads: a text line, a circle or a rectangle.
useWhen: Content with a known layout is loading, such as a card list, a profile or a table, and the wait is short
Keeping the layout still while data arrives, so nothing jumps when it lands
A first load of a section, before any content has been shown
avoidWhen: The layout of the coming content is not known
A short action the person started, such as saving a form
A long task with a known amount of progress

variant.description: The form. Rendered as data-variant, not data-shape: shape words are fixed for controls.

size.description: Text only: the type size of the line it stands for (font.size.s, m, 2xl), with half the normal leading above and below so lines stack like text. Not stamped on circle and rect.

width.description: Inline size, a CSS length or px. Default the full line for text and rect, size.control.md (32px at the default density) for circle. Set through --_skeleton-width.

height.description: Rect only: the block size, a CSS length or px. Default size.control.lg. A circle takes its width.

a11y.role: None. Every skeleton is aria-hidden, whatever the caller passes.
a11y.announce: The skeletons say nothing, so the consumer says it once per region. Keep one visually hidden role="status" element mounted next to the loading container (outside it, since aria-busy can hold back what is inside). Put the words in it when loading starts: Loading members, Arabic جار تحميل الأعضاء. Empty it when the content lands. The container carries aria-busy="true" while the skeletons show. Every case of Skeleton.demo.tsx shows the pattern.
notes: The shimmer plays three times (4.2s, linear, the skeleton-shimmer pattern) and stops, so it needs no pause control (WCAG 2.2.2). Under reduced motion it does not play; the shape stays.
Forced colors draws an outline in the system text color, since the fill is not painted.

en.busy: The container's name says what is loading: Members, Profile. No text inside a skeleton.

ar.busy: Noun form names on the container, no diacritics: الأعضاء، الملف الشخصي.

angular.note: The host element is the root, always aria-hidden. width and height set --_skeleton-width and --_skeleton-height as inline styles, numbers as px. Skeleton.css is used as is.

native.note: A View with the same fill; the shimmer through Reanimated, still under reduce motion.

styles.studio: Tokens only: an overlay-10 fill with a second overlay-10 band sweeping across.
styles.desk: Tokens only: the same overlays, so a skeleton on glass stays visible.

mistakes.wrong: A skeleton for a save the person just started
Skeletons in a container with no aria-busy
mistakes.right: aria-busy="true" on the loading container, removed when the content lands

mistakes.wrong: A skeleton left on screen after the load failed
mistakes.right: Swap it for an ErrorState with a retry action
